definitions.explanation: The highest point of a mountain.

examples.japanese: {山頂|さんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
{山頂|さんちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気圧|きあつ}→気圧：00219_kiatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: The air pressure is low at the mountain top.

examples.japanese: {山頂|さんちょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: We gazed at the scenery from the summit.

notes:
{山頂|さんちょう} specifically means the top of a mountain. The kanji {山|さん} (mountain) + {頂|ちょう} (summit) make the meaning transparent.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {山頂|さんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for the summit
- {山頂|さんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到達|とうたつ}→到達：11815_toutatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reach the summit
- {山頂|さんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the summit
- {山頂|さんちょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: the view from the summit
- {山頂|さんちょう}⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: near the summit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧: summit, top (more general — can refer to the top of anything, not just mountains)
- ⟦{峰|みね}→峰：23001_mine⟧: peak, ridge (emphasizes the pointed shape)
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頂|いただき}: mountain top (literary)

{山頂|さんちょう} is commonly used in hiking and mountaineering contexts.
